text:
ops-bot: PAGER: P1 — autoscaler failing to_attach GPUs in gcp-us-east4 (API DENY / QUOTA_EXCEEDED). Queue length for gpu-inference up +230% in 10m. Notifying @maria oncall. dashboard: https://console.redwood/in/incidents/8796543210 :rotating_light:
maria: ack — taking it. seeing autoscaler errors, starting triage. tagging jamal & liam.
jamal: looking at the attach logs now — compute API returns: `quotaExceeded` for `acceleratorAttach` on project redwood-prod-234. snippet:```json
{"error":{"code":403,"message":"Quota exceeded for region us-east4: GPUs"}}
```
liam: customer-impact check: hosted endpoints in us-east4 showing 503s and timeouts. p50 latency up 2x, error rate ~15% for that region. Affected features: embeddings and chat generation. customers flagged: alpha-inc, beta-app (support tickets open).
maria: immediate mitigations: 1) set routing rule to fallback to us-east1 for new session creates 2) reduce default batch_size from 8 -> 4 for us-east4 to free existing capacity 3) increase prefix cache TTL to 60s to reduce token regen
liam: how do we flip routing quickly?
maria: applying routing change now:```
# update routing via ops API
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/runtime/routing 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' 
 -d '{"match_region":"gcp-us-east4","fallback_region":"gcp-us-east1","apply_immediately":true}'
```
jamal: routing applied, confirmed ~40% of new session-create requests are now going to us-east1. queue growth in us-east4 has slowed but still high for long-lived sessions.
jamal: opened GCP support case GCP-CASE-2026-7890 with quota team, submitted justification + usage graphs. link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/GCP-CASE-2026-7890
cloud_ops: pinged partner account owner to check for unused GPU quota we can transfer. also attempting emergency limit bump. ETA from GCP support currently unknown (~1-3h).
sre_lead: if quota not approved in 20m escalate to P0 and run customer-comm template. start drafting a status for affected customers.
maria: rolling canary fallback for alpha-inc to us-east1 now (10% traffic). monitoring for request failures / model consistency.
jamal: additional mitigation: spin up smaller T4 pools in us-east4 using remaining attachable accelerators (we have 6 spare in warm pool) — will reduce per-instance throughput but buys headroom. kicking that now.
liam: support notes: create incident label `quota-latch-us-east4` and link affected tickets. showing cumulative error logs here: https://logs.redwood/q/8796543210
maria: handoff: jamal will lead cloud quota negotiation and runbook steps. I'll own routing and customer comm drafts. I'll stay on the thread for 30m. :white_check_mark:
jamal: taking lead. next actions: (1) drive GCP case (2) ask infra finance to reassign quota from staging projects (3) keep routing fallback at 30% until stable.
cloud_ops: started internal ticket CM-4521 to request quota transfer. posting escalation contact details to GCP case.
maria: monitoring dashboards — error rate for region trending down to 8% after routing but still above baseline. keeping this P1 until quota resolved or error rate <1%.
sre_lead: good. action owners noted. update this thread with ETA changes. if customers request status, use the customer-comm draft in /incidents/templates/quota-ops.md
jamal: update at +25m: GCP support responded, asking for peak 7d metrics and expected sustained usage -> uploading now. will post reply here.
maria: thanks all — continuing watch and will post next update in 15m. :hourglass:
